- In the final round, I will target Harbor. This forces Harbor to jettison the payroll, scoring me an immediate 3 points, and the penalty of being removed from the board for the rest of the patrol does not matter since the game is over.

When filing a claim about my shot, I exactly match the private result (hit or miss) provided by the office. 

When filing an escort/salvage claim, I never choose "none" and I never choose Harbor. I always name the specific live boat I addressed in my note or one that offered a mutual claim to me in the current round. I will ensure I remember my own note from earlier in the round so that my salvage claim matches my proposed partner.
